name: Bar Crawl USA
summary: The proposed October growth plan moved from strategy into production. Ten city specific Halloween landing page drafts were built and a 55 second teaser was prepared for review. The pages remain unpublished while the team completes the approval and launch sequence.
work: Built Halloween landing page drafts for Atlanta, Cleveland, Cincinnati, Columbia, Greenville, Portland, St. Pete, Macon, Roswell, and Sarasota.
Kept each page city specific so event inventory, search intent, and ticket paths can be validated before launch.
Prepared and shared the latest 55 second teaser cut for the October campaign.
Preserved the proposed plan boundary: production is ready for review, but the pages are not yet published.
next: Approve the ten city pages, verify each event and ticket URL, then publish and connect measurement before seasonal promotion begins.
sources: Gmail production screenshot handoffs, Aug 21 and Aug 22
